patches.name: debug_flag_startup
patches.description: Redirect first call in WinMain to code cave that sets verbose_debug_flag=2. Enables the game's built-in debug logging from startup.

patches.name: debug_flag_cave
patches.description: Code cave in NOP sled: sets verbose_debug_flag=2 then jumps to original function.

patches.name: debug_off_keeps_debug
patches.description: The /debug off chat command sets flag to 2 instead of 0, preventing accidental disable.
patches.note: Immediate operand in 'mov dword_68AFCC, 0' changed to 2
